event_records.description: The permit application is pending review.

applicant.name: Applicant
applicant.persona_brief:
You are Applicant.
The Applicant has submitted a permit application and is awaiting approval. They have no special influence or inside knowledge about the review process.

permit_reviewer.name: Permit Reviewer
permit_reviewer.persona_brief:
You are Permit Reviewer.
The Permit Reviewer is responsible for evaluating the application and making a decision. They have a standard workload and follow established procedures.

resolution.question: Will the permit get approved by the end of August?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the permit was approved by 2026-08-31T17:00:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
